traits.name: Flurry of Blows (2/Short Rest)
traits.text:
If the protector has
attacked this turn, it can make an additional
unarmed strike as a bonus action. On a hit, the
target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving
throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Patient Defense (2/Short Rest)
traits.text:
The protector can
take the Dodge action as a bonus action.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.text:
While not wearing armor, the
protector's AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The protector makes two attacks, one
with its quarterstaff and one with its unarmed
strike.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach
5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning
damage.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit,
reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning
damage.
